definitions.gloss: half a month; about two weeks
definitions.explanation: A period of approximately fifteen days, or half of a calendar month.

examples.japanese: {半月|はんつき}ほど{入院|にゅういん}した。
examples.english: I was hospitalized for about half a month.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しの{準備|じゅんび}に{半月|はんつき}かかった。
examples.english: It took half a month to prepare for the move.

examples.japanese: {半月|はんつき}{前|まえ}に{注文|ちゅうもん}した{商品|しょうひん}がまだ{届|とど}かない。
examples.english: The product I ordered half a month ago still hasn't arrived.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
Read as はんつき when referring to a time period (half a month). The same kanji {半月|はんげつ} read as はんげつ means "half-moon" (the shape or the lunar phase) and is a separate entry.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {半月|はんつき}ほど (about half a month)
- {半月|はんつき}{前|まえ} (half a month ago)
- {半月|はんつき}{後|ご} (half a month later)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {二週間|にしゅうかん}: two weeks (more precise)
- {半年|はんとし}: half a year
